instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem: An adult with a rapidly enlarging pericardial effusion becomes restless and cool. Blood pressure is 78/50 mm Hg, heart rate is 128/min, and jugular venous pressure is elevated. Echocardiography shows right-atrial and right-ventricular diastolic collapse. The client has a pulse, breath sounds are equal, and an experienced drainage team is available. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the condition, 2 actions, and 2 parameters to monitor.
